label: Figure 7.9: The market for lithium
alt: Steep, inelastic lithium supply curve with demand shifting right from D1 to D2, raising price from $12,000 to $24,000 per tonne while quantity rises only from 40 to 48 thousand tonnes.
caption: Lithium supply is steep (inelastic) because new mines take years to open. When demand shifts right from D<sub>1</sub> to D<sub>2</sub> (for example because of electric-vehicle battery demand), price doubles from $12,000 to $24,000 per tonne while quantity rises only from 40 to 48 thousand tonnes.
